UADataType.Description: The xsd lexical form of a typed value, as authored. A subtype of String so that a lexical value is distinguishable from an ordinary string by its DataType rather than by which Variable it came from - the pattern OPC UA already uses for DecimalString, DurationString, DateString and TimeString. The xsd type the form denotes is declared separately, in ValueType.
Whether a shell describes a product model, an individual item, a batch, a role, or none of these. The three granularity levels a product passport is issued at map onto Type, Instance and Batch.

Field.Name: Type
Field.Description: The shell describes a product model rather than an individual item.

Field.Name: Instance
Field.Description: The shell describes one individual physical item.

Field.Name: Batch
Field.Description: The shell describes a production lot.

Field.Name: Role
Field.Description: The shell describes a role rather than a physical asset.

Field.Name: NotApplicable
Field.Description: Asset kind does not apply.

UADataType.Description: Whether an element defines a shape or carries values.

Field.Name: Template
Field.Description: Defines the shape other elements are built from; carries no values for an individual asset.

Field.Name: Instance
Field.Description: Carries values for one asset.

UADataType.Description: Whether a composition entity is managed within its parent or has a shell of its own.

Field.Name: CoManagedEntity
Field.Description: The entity has no shell of its own and is managed within its parent.

Field.Name: SelfManagedEntity
Field.Description: The entity has its own shell, identified by GlobalAssetId; this is what makes a bill of material traversable across organizations.

UADataType.Description: The direction of an event element.

Field.Name: Input
Field.Description: The event is consumed by the element.

Field.Name: Output
Field.Description: The event is produced by the element.

UADataType.Description: Whether an event element is currently active.

Field.Name: Off
Field.Description: The event source is inactive.

Field.Name: On
Field.Description: The event source is active.

UADataType.Description: What a qualifier qualifies, and therefore whether it may change.

Field.Name: ValueQualifier
Field.Description: Qualifies the value and may change during the element's lifetime.

Field.Name: ConceptQualifier
Field.Description: Qualifies the concept and is invariant.

Field.Name: TemplateQualifier
Field.Description: Qualifies the template the element was built from.

UADataType.Description: Whether a reference addresses something inside the model or outside it.

Field.Name: ExternalReference
Field.Description: Points at something outside the metamodel.

Field.Name: ModelReference
Field.Description: Points at a node within the model, navigated key by key.

UADataType.Description: The kind of thing a reference key addresses. The enumeration is closed: a value outside it cannot round-trip, so an implementation rejects it rather than dropping it.
The xsd type a value is expressed in. Several of these have no faithful OPC UA equivalent, which is why a value is carried both as a typed Variable and as its exact lexical form.

Field.Name: Decimal
Field.Description: Arbitrary precision; has no faithful OPC UA equivalent, so RawValue is the normative carrier.

Field.Name: Duration
Field.Description: Has no native OPC UA equivalent; RawValue is the normative carrier.

Field.Name: GYearMonth
Field.Description: Partial date; RawValue is the normative carrier.

Field.Name: Integer
Field.Description: Unbounded; RawValue is the normative carrier.

UADataType.Description: The data type of a concept definition expressed in the IEC 61360 data specification.
The element kind a SubmodelElementList constrains its members to.
Whether an entity is readable without authentication. It advertises the tier so a Consumer can discover it; it does not enforce it.

Field.Name: Public
Field.Description: Readable without authentication.

Field.Name: Controlled
Field.Description: Requires an authenticated role.

UADataType.Description: One step of a reference path. Keys are ordered, and the order is part of the reference's meaning.

Field.Name: Type
Field.Description: The kind of thing this key addresses.

Field.Name: Value
Field.Description: The identifier value at this key.

UADataType.Description: A reference, external or model-navigating, expressed as an ordered key path.

Field.Name: Type
Field.Description: Whether the reference is external or navigates the model.

Field.Name: ReferredSemanticId
Field.Description: The semantic identifier of the thing referred to, where known.

Field.Name: Keys
Field.Description: The ordered key path. At least one key is present.

UADataType.Description: One language-tagged string. A multi-language value is an array of these, and the array order is preserved.

Field.Name: Language
Field.Description: BCP 47 language tag.

Field.Name: Text
Field.Description: The text in that language.

UADataType.Description: A domain-specific key an asset is discoverable by.

Field.Name: Name
Field.Description: The key name, for example serialNumber or manufacturerPartId.

Field.Name: Value
Field.Description: The key value.

Field.Name: ExternalSubjectId
Field.Description: The subject this key is disclosed to, where the key is not public.

Field.Name: SemanticId
Field.Description: The concept this key is an occurrence of.

Field.Name: SupplementalSemanticIds
Field.Description: Further concepts this key corresponds to.

UADataType.Description: Administrative information. It records a single current revision: the entity's history is carried by the registry, which the metamodel has no equivalent of.

Field.Name: Version
Field.Description: Version label.

Field.Name: Revision
Field.Description: Revision label; only meaningful when Version is present.

Field.Name: Creator
Field.Description: The party that created the entity.

Field.Name: TemplateId
Field.Description: The template the entity was built from.

Field.Name: EmbeddedDataSpecifications
Field.Description: Data specifications carried by this administrative information.

UADataType.Description: A qualifier constraining or annotating an element.

Field.Name: Kind
Field.Description: What the qualifier qualifies.

Field.Name: Type
Field.Description: The qualifier type name.

Field.Name: ValueType
Field.Description: The xsd type the value is expressed in.

Field.Name: Value
Field.Description: The value in its exact lexical form.

Field.Name: ValueId
Field.Description: A reference to the value, where it is itself an identified concept.

Field.Name: SemanticId
Field.Description: The concept this qualifier is an occurrence of.

Field.Name: SupplementalSemanticIds
Field.Description: Further concepts this qualifier corresponds to.

UADataType.Description: A data specification carried by an element, paired with its content.

Field.Name: DataSpecification
Field.Description: Reference to the data specification template.

Field.Name: DataSpecificationContent
Field.Description: The content, in the IEC 61360 data specification.

UADataType.Description: The IEC 61360 data specification content of a concept definition.

Field.Name: PreferredName
Field.Description: Preferred name per language.

Field.Name: ShortName
Field.Description: Short name per language.

Field.Name: Unit
Field.Description: Unit symbol.

Field.Name: UnitId
Field.Description: Reference to the unit concept.

Field.Name: SourceOfDefinition
Field.Description: Where the definition comes from.

Field.Name: Symbol
Field.Description: Symbol for the concept.

Field.Name: DataType
Field.Description: The IEC 61360 data type.

Field.Name: Definition
Field.Description: Definition per language.

Field.Name: ValueFormat
Field.Description: Format of the value.

Field.Name: ValueList
Field.Description: Permitted values, serialized in the metamodel's own form.

Field.Name: Value
Field.Description: The value in its exact lexical form.

Field.Name: LevelType
Field.Description: Which of min, nom, typ and max apply.

UADataType.Description: A proprietary extension carried on a Referable. Extensions round-trip verbatim; a reader that does not understand one preserves it unchanged.

Field.Name: Name
Field.Description: Extension name.

Field.Name: ValueType
Field.Description: The xsd type the value is expressed in.

Field.Name: Value
Field.Description: The value in its exact lexical form.

Field.Name: RefersTo
Field.Description: What the extension refers to.

Field.Name: SemanticId
Field.Description: The concept this extension is an occurrence of.

Field.Name: SupplementalSemanticIds
Field.Description: Further concepts this extension corresponds to.

UADataType.Description: A pointer to external content, such as a thumbnail.

Field.Name: Path
Field.Description: Path or URL to the resource.

Field.Name: ContentType
Field.Description: Media type of the resource.

UADataType.Description: One input, output or in-out variable of an operation, carried as a reference to the element node that holds it so that the element's own representation is not duplicated.

Field.Name: ValueNodeId
Field.Description: The submodel element node carrying this variable.

UADataType.Description: One authorization option a Consumer may use. It is authorization configuration only and never carries credentials, which are supplied out of band.

Field.Name: Type
Field.Description: Authorization type, for example OAuth2, Plain, SASL, X509Cert or APIKey.

Field.Name: Mechanism
Field.Description: SASL mechanism name, used only when Type is SASL.

Field.Name: ResourceUri
Field.Description: The resource authorization is requested for.

Field.Name: AuthorityUri
Field.Description: The authority authorization is obtained from.

UADataType.Description: A signature or attestation attached to a package. Its presence is not verification: a Consumer retrieves and verifies the artifact itself.

Field.Name: ArtifactType
Field.Description: Media type identifying what kind of attestation this is.

Field.Name: Digest
Field.Description: Digest of the attestation artifact.

Field.Name: Signer
Field.Description: The party that produced the attestation.

UAObjectType.Description: Abstract base of everything in the metamodel that can be referred to by a short name. Carries the identifying and descriptive attributes every element has.

UAVariable.Description: The short name, unique only within its parent. It is never an identifier: two elements from different publishers routinely share one. Absent for an element inside a SubmodelElementList, which is addressed by index instead.
Deprecated in the metamodel and retained only so that a document carrying it round-trips unchanged.
Display name per language.
Description per language.
Proprietary extensions, preserved verbatim.
The metamodel class name of this element. It is redundant with the ObjectType and is carried so that a serialization produced from the AddressSpace is byte-identical to the one that produced it.

UAObjectType.Description: Abstract base of the metamodel elements that carry a globally unique identifier: shells, submodels and concept descriptions.

UAVariable.Description: The globally unique identifier, up to 2048 characters. It is arbitrary text and can never be a BrowseName, so it is carried here and the node is named by the derived identifier instead.
Administrative information: a single current revision, with no history.

UAObjectType.Description: Abstract base of the elements that declare what concept they are an occurrence of.

UAVariable.Description: The concept this element is an occurrence of. It is what makes an element discoverable by meaning rather than by name.
Further concepts this element corresponds to, which is how one element is made discoverable through more than one dictionary.

UAObjectType.Description: Abstract base of the elements that distinguish a template from an instance.

UAVariable.Description: Whether this element defines a shape or carries values.

UAObjectType.Description: Abstract base of the elements that carry data specifications.

UAVariable.Description: Data specifications carried by this element.

UAObjectType.Description: Abstract base of the elements that can be qualified.

UAVariable.Description: Qualifiers constraining or annotating this element.

UAObjectType.Description: The container of shells, submodels and concept descriptions - the unit an AAS serialization carries and the root a source generator materializes into a Server.

UAObject.Description: A shell held by this environment.
A submodel held by this environment. Submodels are top-level: one submodel may be referenced by several shells, which is why they are not nested inside them.
A concept description held by this environment.

UAObjectType.Description: An Asset Administration Shell: the digital representation of one asset, carrying the asset's identity and references to the submodels that describe it.

UAObject.Description: The identity of the asset this shell represents.

UAVariable.Description: References to the submodels describing this asset. A submodel is not owned by the shell that references it.
The Type shell this Instance shell was derived from, so an individual item can be traced to its product model.
Data specifications carried by this shell.

UAObjectType.Description: The identity of the asset a shell represents, as distinct from the identity of the shell itself.

UAVariable.Description: Whether the asset is a product model, an individual item, a batch, a role, or none of these.

The globally unique identifier of the asset itself. Where the asset carries an identification link, that link is this value, and it is what connects a code scanned from a physical product to this Server.
The identifier of the asset type this asset is an occurrence of.
The additional keys the asset is discoverable by.
A pointer to a representative image of the asset.

UAObjectType.Description: One coherent aspect of an asset, identified in its own right and typed by its SemanticId: a nameplate, technical data, a carbon footprint, a bill of material.

UAVariable.Description: Whether this submodel carries values or defines a shape other submodels are built from.
The concept this submodel is an occurrence of.
Further concepts this submodel corresponds to.
Qualifiers on this submodel.
Data specifications carried by this submodel.

UAObjectType.Description: The definition a SemanticId resolves to - what makes two submodels from different vendors comparable.

UAVariable.Description: Concepts in other dictionaries this concept corresponds to, which is how a Server bridges two classification systems without asserting that either is canonical.
The data specifications defining this concept.

UAObjectType.Description: Abstract base of every element that can appear inside a submodel.

UAVariable.Description: The concept this element is an occurrence of.
Further concepts this element corresponds to.
Qualifiers on this element.
Data specifications carried by this element.

The element's position within its parent SubmodelElementList. OPC UA References are unordered, so an ordered collection carries its order explicitly or loses it. Present only for an element inside a list.

UAObjectType.Description: A single typed value. The value is carried twice: as a typed Variable for the native projection a generic Client expects, and as its exact lexical form, because several xsd types have no faithful OPC UA equivalent.

UAVariable.Description: The xsd type the value is expressed in.
The value in its native OPC UA representation, for reading. Where the declared ValueType cannot be represented faithfully, this is the nearest representation and RawValue is authoritative.
The value in the exact xsd lexical form the metamodel carries. This is the normative carrier for round-tripping: where it and Value disagree, RawValue wins.
A reference to the value, where the value is itself an identified concept.

UAObjectType.Description: A value expressed in one or more languages. The array order is preserved, because the metamodel's serialization is ordered and a round trip that reordered it would not reproduce its input.

UAVariable.Description: The language-tagged values, in order.
A reference to the value, where the value is itself an identified concept.

UAObjectType.Description: A closed or half-open interval of a single typed value.

UAVariable.Description: The xsd type the bounds are expressed in.
The lower bound in its exact lexical form. Absent means unbounded below, which is different from a bound of zero.
The upper bound in its exact lexical form. Absent means unbounded above.

UAObjectType.Description: Binary content carried inline.

UAVariable.Description: The content bytes.
Media type of the content.

UAObjectType.Description: A pointer to content held outside the element.

UAVariable.Description: Path or URL to the content.
Media type of the content.

UAObjectType.Description: An element whose value is a reference.

UAVariable.Description: The reference.

UAObjectType.Description: A directed relationship between two referenced things.

UAVariable.Description: The first, or source, end of the relationship.
The second, or target, end of the relationship.

UAObjectType.Description: A relationship carrying data elements that annotate it, such as a quantity or a position.

UAObject.Description: A data element annotating this relationship.

UAObjectType.Description: An unordered set of elements, each identified by its own IdShort.
An ordered sequence of elements. Its members have no IdShort, so they are named by index and carry their position in Index; that is what lets the sequence be reconstructed from a Browse result.

UAVariable.Description: Whether the order carries meaning. Order is preserved either way, because a round trip must reproduce its input whether or not the order is significant.
The element kind every member is constrained to.
The concept every member is an occurrence of, where they share one.
The xsd type every member's value is expressed in, where they share one.

UAObject.Description: A member of this list, named by its index. Referenced with HasOrderedComponent because the collection is a sequence; Index carries the position that makes the sequence recoverable.

UAObjectType.Description: A component of a composition. A self-managed entity carries the identifier of its own shell, which is what makes a bill of material traversable across organizations.

UAVariable.Description: Whether the component has its own shell or is managed within its parent.
The identifier of the component's own asset, for a self-managed entity.
Additional keys the component is discoverable by.

UAObjectType.Description: An event source or sink.

UAVariable.Description: What the event observes.
Whether the event is produced or consumed.
Whether the event source is active.
The topic events are delivered on. Where the delivery endpoint is itself catalogued, the registry entry points at it.
The broker delivering the events.
When the event last fired, in its exact lexical form.
Minimum interval between events, in its exact lexical form.
Maximum interval between events, in its exact lexical form.

UAObjectType.Description: An invocable operation.

UAVariable.Description: The operation's input variables, in order.
The operation's output variables, in order.
The operation's in-out variables, in order.

UAObject.Description: An element carrying one of the operation's variables.

UAObjectType.Description: A declared capability of the asset. It carries no value of its own; the element's identity and semantics are the whole of its content.

The AAS Registry root - an xRegistry RegistryType, and therefore a FolderType - whose group folders hold shells, submodel templates, concept dictionaries and packages. Exposed as a well-known object under the Server object, so any Client that reaches the standard Server object discovers it.

UAObject.Description: A shell folder held by the registry.
A submodel template family held by the registry.
A concept dictionary held by the registry.
A package store held by the registry.

UAMethod.Description: Return the shells discoverable by an asset key. This is the discovery question - given a serial number or a part identifier, which shells describe it - answered without the caller browsing the whole collection.

Description.Text: The key name, for example serialNumber.
The shell group nodes matching the key.

UAMethod.Description: Return a submodel document and enough metadata to parse it, given its identifier. The method form of the document fast path, for a Client that has an identifier rather than a node.

UAObjectType.Description: An xRegistry GroupType holding the submodel documents of one shell. Its source identity is the shell's authored identifier, from which the GroupId is constructed. It is distinct from AASType, which models the same shell as a live node tree rather than as a catalogue entry.

UAVariable.Description: The shell's authored identifier, verbatim. It is the group's source identity: the GroupId is the symbolic identifier constructed from it, and Name is this identifier.
Whether the shell describes a product model, an individual item or a batch.
The identifier of the asset itself, as distinct from the shell describing it.
The identifier of the asset type this asset is an occurrence of.
The keys this shell is discoverable by.
Administrative information carried by the shell.
The identifier of the Type shell this Instance shell was derived from.
Whether this entity is readable without authentication.
The authorization options a Consumer may use to obtain access.
The catalogued endpoint delivering change events for this shell, where one is published.

The AASType node modelling this same shell as a live node tree, where the Server also implements the metamodel half. The catalogue entry and the node tree are different nodes for the same shell, and this is the link between them.

UAObject.Description: A submodel document held by this shell.

UAObjectType.Description: An xRegistry ResourceType whose file content is one submodel document. Each version is one revision, which is what gives a shell the lifecycle history the metamodel does not itself provide.

UAVariable.Description: The submodel's authored identifier, verbatim. It is the resource's source identity, from which the ResourceId is constructed, and it is invariant across the submodel's versions.
The concept this submodel is an occurrence of - the attribute a Consumer filters on to find, for example, every carbon footprint submodel in a registry.
Further concepts this submodel corresponds to.
Whether the submodel carries values or defines a shape.
The identifier of the template this submodel was built from. It is an identifier and not a pointer, so it resolves identically whether or not this registry also serves the template.
Digest of the exact document bytes a Consumer retrieves. A registry does not publish one for bytes it has not itself seen.
The algorithm used to compute Digest. Present whenever Digest is.
Whether this is the version served when none is selected.
The version this one derives from. A root version's ancestor is itself.
Whether this document is readable without authentication. A document is wholly one tier or the other: a boundary falling between elements inside a document cannot be expressed here.
The authorization options a Consumer may use to obtain access.
The AASSubmodelType node modelling this same submodel as a live node tree, where the Server also implements the metamodel half.

UAObjectType.Description: An xRegistry GroupType holding one publisher's family of submodel templates. Keeping templates in a group of their own is what lets a Consumer building a new asset list templates while a Consumer reading an asset lists instances.

UAVariable.Description: The publisher's template namespace, verbatim. It is the group's source identity.
The organization publishing this template family.

UAObject.Description: A submodel template held by this family.

UAObjectType.Description: An xRegistry GroupType holding one dictionary of concept definitions - the definitions a SemanticId elsewhere in the registry resolves to.

UAVariable.Description: The dictionary's identifier, verbatim. It is the group's source identity.

UAObject.Description: A concept definition held by this dictionary.

UAObjectType.Description: An xRegistry ResourceType whose file content is one concept description document.

UAVariable.Description: The concept's authored identifier, verbatim, which is the value that appears as a SemanticId elsewhere. It is the resource's source identity. Dictionary identifiers frequently use a syntax unrelated to any URI scheme, which is precisely why the identifier is carried here and the node is named by the derived one.
Concepts in other dictionaries this concept corresponds to.

UAObjectType.Description: An xRegistry GroupType holding packages - one store, or one namespace within one.

UAVariable.Description: The store's identifier, verbatim. It is the group's source identity.
Base URL of the backing package store.

UAObject.Description: A package held by this store.

UAObjectType.Description: An xRegistry ResourceType whose file content is one package: an immutable release addressed by digest and optionally attested by signatures.

UAVariable.Description: The package's name as held by the backing store, verbatim. It is the resource's source identity.
The media type identifying what the artifact is, where the backing store carries one.
Digest of the exact package bytes. This is the integrity anchor: a version identifies which release a Consumer wants, a digest identifies what that release contains.
The algorithm used to compute Digest.
The shell identifiers this package contains, so a Consumer can tell what it holds without retrieving and opening it.
The digest of the artifact this one attests, where it is an attestation rather than a package.
The signatures and attestations attached to this package.

UAObject.Description: Server-wide AAS Registry, a well-known component of the Server object.

UAMethod.Description: Return the shells discoverable by an asset key. The functional method on the well-known AASRegistry object.

Description.Text: The key name, for example serialNumber.
The shell group nodes matching the key.

UAMethod.Description: Return a submodel document and enough metadata to parse it, given its identifier. The functional method on the well-known AASRegistry object.
